diagnosis.conclusion: After eight-column packing, dense raw Q8 still led the 4K Amdahl ledger because every prompt row reread the same encoded weight rows.

change.summary: Compute exact raw-Q8 projections in bounded row/output tiles while preserving every scalar dot-product association.

retained_tiles.8x4: rows >= 8 for wider outputs, and all rows >= 32

change.fallback: The prior exact pack8 kernel remains selected below eight rows; explicit WMMA still has precedence; unaligned and non-Q8 shapes keep existing fallbacks.
change.exactness: Each thread visits k=tid+128*n in the old order, each accumulator uses the same wave32 shuffle tree and wave-0..3 cross-wave sum, and only independent rows/columns are interleaved.

red_green.primitive_red: Imports for the missing exact tile8x2 and tile8x4 wrappers failed during test collection before their kernels and registry keys existed.
red_green.dispatch_red: The rows=8 package policy still selected pack8/tile4x4 instead of the measured 8x2/8x4 crossover.
red_green.retained_scope: The measured but inferior exact tile4x4 candidate was removed before retention.
